headline_seed: Middle East crisis live: US envoy and Trump’s son-in-law to travel to Pakistan amid hopes for renewed Iran peace talks
description_seed: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to travel to Pakistan, White House says; Iranian state media says foreign minister Abbas Araqchi traveling to Islamabad, Muscat and Moscow The EU’s foreign chief has said that talks with Iran should include nuclear experts otherwise “we will end up with a more dangerous Iran.” Speaking on Friday ahead of an informal summit of EU leaders in Cyprus, EU’s foreign chief Kaja Kallas said: “If the talks are only about the nuclear and there are no nuclear experts around the table, then we will end up with an agreement that is weaker than the JCPOA was.” Continue reading...

Iran news LIVE updates: US President Donald Trump's special envoy to Middle East Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner will travel to Pakistan on Saturday morning for talks with Iran, White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt told Fox News. Vice president JD Vance is currently not planning to attend, but will be on standby to travel to Islamabad if negotiations progress, CNN reported....Read More

Iran news LIVE updates: Iran foreign minister has landed in Islamabad amid chatter over second round of talks between Tehran and Washington in Pakistani capital city. US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will leave for Pakistan on Saturday morning as White House confirmed talks. However, Al Jazeera quoted an Iranian official saying that there won't be any talks with the US as Araghchi is visiting Pakistan, Oman and Russia to discuss regional developments.
Iran news LIVE updates: Pakistan’s Foreign Ministry said an Iranian delegation led by Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi arrived in Islamabad on Friday.
